original_test_intent: Validate the eight-position M-suffixed UBB GPU sensor family as defined by the approved platform sensor specification, ensuring each member's meaning, current reading and enabled thresholds are human-readable and consistent across IPMI and both BMC-Web locations.
original_method: Before collection, the platform owner defines the M suffix and maps GPU0M–GPU7M to physical components and exact sensor records. Automation gathers complete per-member readings and threshold metadata, while an operator confirms the same mapped entries in Dashboard and Server Health.
manual_activity: The platform thermal owner defines the M suffix, maps each 0M–7M member to a physical sensor domain and exact SDR/Web entry, supplies expected values and threshold masks, then reviews both Web views. No meaning is inherited from neighboring rows.
required_inputs: Authoritative definition of `M` for this platform and its distinction from unsuffixed GPU and explicit GPU Memory sensors
Installed GPU0M–GPU7M applicability and physical component/location map
Exact SDR name/number/entity and Dashboard/Server Health row per member
Sensor reading units, scale, tolerance, freshness and unavailable semantics
Enabled threshold mask and expected lower/upper noncritical, critical and nonrecoverable values
BMC/SDR/GPU/UBB firmware versions and versioned sensor specification
Secret-safe access, complete raw and screenshot capture, and log-retention policy
Thermal aborts and independent cooling/BMC recovery owner
safety_requirements: Do not interpret M as memory, module, midpoint or any other meaning without the approved project definition
Do not reuse evidence from TEMP_UBB_GPU0~7 or TEMP_GPU 0~N_Memory
Enumerate 0M through 7M by exact sensor identifiers; the tilde notation is not an executable name expansion
Retain the full SDR inventory and threshold-access flags; no 100-line cap
Never modify thresholds, generate thermal load, control fans/GPUs, reset BMC or clear logs
Stop on semantic mismatch, missing/stale/invalid reading, unsafe temperature, threshold discrepancy or BMC instability
Protect credentials and do not automatically retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify row identity and approved M-suffix semantics
Capture complete SDR/Sensor inventory and exact per-member read-only results
Bind every 0M–7M sensor to its approved physical component and parse enabled thresholds
Construct a semantic-labeled comparison for Dashboard and Server Health confirmation
Perform no semantic inference, threshold write, stimulus, control action or verdict
engineer_actions: Define M and approve its non-overlap with adjacent sensor families
Approve member applicability and physical/SDR/Web mappings
Provide reading ranges and enabled threshold expectations
Confirm both Web paths and issue the final per-member and overall result

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A read-only exact `sensor get` can contribute evidence after member names are known, but `'TEMP_UBB_GPU0M~7M'` is a testcase range label rather than proof of eight queries. The capped fallback, exposed secret and missing semantic/Web evidence make the command insufficient.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Once the owner defines M and enumerates exact names, use secret-safe OOB access to retain the full SDR inventory and query every 0M–7M record separately, including threshold-access flags; compare those records with both Web pages.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: TEMP_UBB_GPU0M~7M, Dashboard and Server Health navigation, human-readable reading/threshold criterion and 1/1-minute estimates remain; M semantics and values are deliberately not inferred.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES M-SUFFIX SEMANTIC AND SENSOR-MAPPING PACKAGE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Publish a versioned definition and physical map for the M family, enumerate all applicable records, normalize only enabled thresholds and reconcile machine evidence with both human-facing Web views.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds the missing semantic identity gate and replaces the literal range query with exact per-member collection.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: An unsuffixed GPU reading or explicitly named memory reading cannot satisfy an undefined M-family sensor; one literal query and partial SDR listing also cannot prove eight members.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Passive collection is low impact, but guessing M or accepting a wrong threshold can create a false thermal-health conclusion.

project_override_considerations: If M is officially documented as memory, module or another domain, that definition must cite the platform sensor specification and show how this row differs from other named sensor families. Unpopulated indices require explicit not-applicable decisions.
expected_evidence: Approved M definition and non-overlap statement for adjacent sensor families
GPU0M–GPU7M physical membership/applicability and exact SDR/Web mapping
Per-member reading semantics, units, state, freshness and enabled-threshold table
Complete redacted SDR plus exact per-member outputs with status/timestamps
Dashboard and Server Health screenshots/exports bearing the approved semantic labels
Per-member comparison, missing/extra/stale audit and passive thermal/SEL/BMC health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The row consistently identifies an M-suffixed sensor family and asks for readings/thresholds in two Web views. The suffix is undefined, but there is no competing meaning within this exact row; its definition is an explicit project readiness input and must not be borrowed from adjacent rows.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A distinct passive M-suffixed sensor-family check is identifiable. ED-36 allows the owner to supply its semantic and physical mapping; until then execution is not ready, but the review need not invent a meaning or declare an irreducible source conflict.

review_improvement: Introduces a hard semantic gate for M, keeps three neighboring GPU sensor families atomic, requires true eight-member collection and preserves threshold enablement and both human-facing views.
independent_technical_reasoning: Suffixes in platform SDR names are vendor conventions, not universal protocol semantics. Because this library separately names unsuffixed UBB GPU and GPU Memory sensors, assuming M means memory would risk duplicate counting or wrong thermal-domain acceptance. The record can still be reviewed as a distinct owner-mapped sensor family: execution proceeds only after a versioned M definition ties each exact record to a physical component and threshold table.
